FAQ

Common questions.

Do I need any tech skills to use Apex? +
None at all. Apex is built for everyday professionals — not developers. If you can type and click, you can use it fully within minutes.
How is Apex different from ChatGPT or other AI tools? +
Apex is purpose-built for career acceleration with structured tools — not a blank chat box. It gives you actionable outputs you can use immediately: resume bullets, negotiation scripts, week-by-week plans.
Is this a subscription? +
No. Apex is a one-time payment of $79. You pay once and keep access — no recurring charges, no billing cycles, no surprises. All sales are final.
What industries does Apex work for? +
Apex works for any professional role — transportation, operations, finance, tech, healthcare, government, retail, and more. The AI adapts to your specific industry and target role.
Is my data private? +
Yes. Your career data is private to your account and never sold or shared. Payments are processed securely by Stripe — we never store your card details.
